task: claude-code-acp bridge refuses to start because it inherits CLAUDECODE from Chorus's own launch environment
brief_thickness: medium — symptom + confirmed root cause, no exact line, no code shown

run.method: git worktree at parent commit 187c0a8, brief prompt via acp-probe --allow
run.verify: cargo test -p chorus-acp = 4/5 suites passed, clippy -p chorus-acp = 0 warnings (both re-run independently after the probe)

brief.goal: a bridge spawned by Chorus must never see CLAUDECODE / CLAUDE_CODE_* markers, so claude-code-acp doesn't refuse thinking it's nested
done: confirmed the failure is env-based: Claude Code sets CLAUDECODE (and related CLAUDE_CODE_* vars) in its subprocess environment, inherited by whatever Chorus spawns
pending: strip those vars when spawning any bridge, harmless for codex/gemini too
constraints: cargo test and clippy must stay green
